Counters.Counter tracking the current token id; incremented in mintItem.

Mint price in wei (0.0420 ether); compared against msg.value in mintItem.

Payable public mint function: validates price and supply, forwards msg.value to blindnabler via a low-level call, then increments the counter, mints the token and derives pseudo-random color/chubbiness values from blockhash(block.number-1).
View override that assembles the base64 JSON metadata (name, description, external_url, attributes, owner, base64 SVG image) for a token id.
Internal view that wraps renderTokenById output inside an SVG document with gradient and pattern definitions.
Public view that loads per-token color/depth parameters and kicks off the recursive fractal rendering.
Pure helper computing the three branch coordinates (A, B, C) of a fractal fork using unchecked unsigned arithmetic.
Public view recursive renderer that draws a fork and recurses into two branches until depth reaches maxdepth.
Pure helper that converts fork() coordinates into an SVG <g> element with two coloured lines.
Caller-supplied address used as the mint recipient and as entropy input for the pseudo-random color generation.
blindnabler.call{value: msg.value}("") executed before the counter increment and _mint, allowing an external contract under that address to re-enter mintItem while state is not yet updated.

edges.reason: _tokenIds counter is read and incremented during mintItem.
maxSupply is compared with the current token id in mintItem.
price is compared with msg.value in mintItem.
color1[id] is written from the predictable pseudo-random hash in mintItem.
color2[id] is written from the predictable pseudo-random hash in mintItem.
color3[id] is written from the predictable pseudo-random hash in mintItem.
color4[id] is written from the predictable pseudo-random hash in mintItem.
chubbiness[id] is computed and stored in mintItem.
maxdepth[id] is derived from chubbiness and stored in mintItem.
msg.sender is used as the mint recipient and as entropy in the random hash.
blindnabler is the target address of the low-level value transfer.
mintItem makes an external low-level call forwarding msg.value before the counter increment and _mint, so the recipient can re-enter with stale state.
The executed call forwards msg.value to the blindnabler address.
tokenURI reads color1[id] to build the attributes and description.
tokenURI reads color2[id] to build the attributes and description.
tokenURI reads chubbiness[id] for the baselength attribute.
tokenURI reads maxdepth[id] for the description text.
generateSVGofTokenById reads color3[id] for the gradient stop.
generateSVGofTokenById reads color4[id] for the gradient stop.
renderTokenById reads chubbiness[id] as the base length.
renderTokenById reads color1[id] for the first stroke colour.
renderTokenById reads color2[id] for the second stroke colour.
renderTokenById reads maxdepth[id] as the recursion bound.
tokenURI calls generateSVGofTokenById to embed the SVG image.
generateSVGofTokenById calls renderTokenById for the fractal markup.
renderTokenById initiates the recursive fractal rendering.
fractal calls drawFork at each recursion level.
drawFork calls fork to obtain branch coordinates.
fractal recurses into itself for both branches until depth equals maxdepth.
Token id argument is consumed by tokenURI.
Token id argument is consumed by generateSVGofTokenById.
Token id argument is consumed by renderTokenById.
Ax is used in the unchecked coordinate arithmetic of fork.
Ay is used in the unchecked coordinate arithmetic of fork.
baselength is used in the unchecked coordinate arithmetic of fork.
input string is accumulated and returned by fractal.
x is decremented and incremented to derive branch origins in fractal.
y is shifted upward each recursion in fractal.
baselength is halved and subtracted/added in fractal.
depth drives the recursion termination check in fractal.
_maxdepth is the recursion termination target in fractal.
_color1 is forwarded to drawFork by fractal.
_color2 is forwarded to drawFork by fractal.
_x1 is passed to fork from drawFork.
_y1 is passed to fork from drawFork.
baselength is passed to fork from drawFork.
_color1 is embedded in the first SVG line stroke.
_color2 is embedded in the second SVG line stroke.
mintItem assigns the low-level call result to success.
mintItem derives the new token id into the local id.
renderTokenById stores chubbiness[id] in baselength.
renderTokenById converts color1[id] into the _color1 string.
renderTokenById converts color2[id] into the _color2 string.
renderTokenById stores maxdepth[id] in _maxdepth.
renderTokenById captures the fractal() output in render.
x1 = x - baselength is unchecked unsigned subtraction in fractal and can underflow.
x2 = x + baselength is unchecked unsigned addition in fractal and can overflow.
fractal stores the left recursive call result in branch1.
fractal stores the right recursive call result in branch2.
drawFork stores the fork() coordinate array in coords.
Bx = Ax - baselength is unchecked unsigned subtraction and can underflow.
By = Ay - (baselength * 2) is unchecked unsigned multiplication/subtraction and can overflow or underflow.
Cx = Ax + baselength is unchecked unsigned addition and can overflow.
